chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn, from his father Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about circumcising the child on the seventh day, is it from the Sunnah or can it be delayed, and which of the two is preferable? He (peace be upon him) said: 'For the seventh day is from the Sunnah, and if it is delayed, there is no problem.'
ai.seo_question: What is the preferred time for circumcising a child according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the fiqh of infant circumcision by affirming the seventh day as the preferred Sunnah while validating flexibility for delayed performance. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing prophetic tradition with practical ease, ensuring the ritual remains accessible without imposing undue hardship on the family or child.
